candidates.reason: Simply shrinks the tall skyscraper into the centre of a wide canvas: 'Glow', the subcopy and the 'Shop Now' button are tiny, the SOLSTICE logo and the bottle label can't be read, both sides are large empty areas, and the big bubble sits behind the CTA with no clear purpose. It doesn't rearrange anything for the new format.

Sensible two-column rearrangement: the product is on the left and the headline, subcopy and CTA form a clear, well-sized stack on the right. But the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck floating above 'Glow', so the brand is effectively lost. The bottom-left is dead space and the product is a little small next to the bold copy.

Almost the same as candidate 2, with the same unreadable speck of a logo above the headline. The product is slightly smaller and pushed closer to the left edge, which makes the left column feel weaker and the canvas more lopsided toward the copy.

The headline, subcopy and CTA read well on the right, but the SOLSTICE logo has been moved below the CTA at the bottom, where it is a tiny, illegible afterthought. That breaks the brand-first reading order. 'Glow' sits close to the top edge, and the product floats high on the left with empty space beneath it.
